items.headline: Hazardous Seas Warning issued November 9 at 12:52AM PST until November 9 at 4:00AM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Hazardous Seas Warning, very steep and
hazardous seas 12 to 16 ft at 15 seconds and southeast winds
10 to 15 kt. For the Gale Warning, seas 11 to 16 ft at 15
seconds and south winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt
expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Cape Shoalwater to Florence out 60
NM.

* WHEN...Hazardous Seas Warning, until 4 AM PST early this
morning. Gale Warning, from 4 AM early this morning to 10 AM
PST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...There will be a lull in gusty winds Monday
night in between weather systems before winds increase quickly
Tuesday morning.
items.instruction:
A Gale Warning means winds of 34 to 47 knots are imminent or
occurring. Operating a vessel in gale conditions requires
experience and properly equipped vessels. It is highly
recommended that mariners without the proper experience seek safe
harbor prior to the onset of gale conditions.
